decisions.reason: Launched only a year ago, the secure channel fits the firm's core security platform, and with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations there is no trigger for problemistic search, so slack lets it continue.
Mobile PDF signing complements the signature portfolio and serves growing regulatory demand (eIDAS), so a one-year-old feature with uncertain results is likely retained.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture is close to the firm's core competence and underpins other offerings, making a drop unlikely.
The email-to-app delivery robot is more niche and could be folded into other products if it falls short, but one year is too early to judge against aspirations.

The hardware token carries production and distribution costs and faces competition from app-based authentication, which raises the risk somewhat, yet it remains consistent with the firm's banking-security focus.
Payment security compliance offers steady regulatory-driven demand from financial clients, likely meeting aspirations and justifying retention.
